snippet.title: Samus Goes to the Fridge to Get a Glass of Milk 3D - Trailer
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD: https://forum.metroidconstruction.com/index.php/topic,5372
The milk saga hits Metroid Prime. Frustrated with Adam's picky tastes, Samus sets out to the frigate to solve this milk debacle once and for all.
